participation.context: Spoke the nine and the kerchief, and slept on not knowing.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Not here. The kerchief is for her, and you do not know if it has arrived.
participation.name: Anne Shakespeare

participation.context: Not here. The shop you named is his.
participation.name: John Shakespeare

story.body: You counted nine at the home table, put your stool back in the shop, and left the kerchief unknown. You did not send a letter to settle it.

title: Thought of nine at the other table
